# HaruQuantAI V3 — Feature–Requirement Traceability Register

**Version 1.0 · 6 September 2026 · Separate ownership and acceptance register**

## 1. Decision and scope

**The selected decomposition contains 205 features across 18 domains.** Each card defines a distinct public value, an explicit in/out boundary, functional obligations, quality constraints, dependencies, delivered catalogues and acceptance evidence. This is a specification/traceability artifact, not a claim that these features have been implemented or that all target contracts are already registered.

Source: [`docs/dev/SQX/HaruQuantAI_Unified_Specification.md`](https://github.com/haruperi/HaruQuantAI/blob/c06456fe2c03bc89f52edad1a0a8428118287377/docs/dev/SQX/HaruQuantAI_Unified_Specification.md), commit `c06456fe2c03bc89f52edad1a0a8428118287377`, Git blob `7b592a2c25276ceae7cf7011f0a4f98eabe9c7fd`. The original specification is unchanged. No repository commit or production implementation was performed for this register.

**What is closed:** the curated source scope has feature owners, boundaries, requirement/refinement links, catalogue owners, applicable shared constraints, declared dependencies and acceptance obligations. **What is not certified:** current runtime binding, implementation completeness, the unprovided full 572-class donor inventory, external format grammars, real-provider support or measured performance. Those evidence dependencies have named owners and blocking acceptance conditions in §10; they are not silently treated as completed work.

**Do not add 389 to 575.** Original source rows, master summaries, normalized FRs and catalogue entries are different traceability layers. A source row can be refined by several owned FRs; a shared rule can apply to many features. These links are not duplicate implementation tasks or independent counts of user behaviors.

### 1.1 The feature test

A feature must answer: what useful outcome does it deliver, to which caller, through which public boundary; what does it explicitly not own; what independent test proves the outcome; and what disappears when the feature is removed? Multiple algorithms may implement that one outcome. Multiple UI controls may invoke it. A pure schema, helper, role profile, release milestone, test suite, source class or single route is not automatically a feature.

```text
HaruQuantAI V3
└── Domain
    └── Feature — exact FEAT-* identity
        ├── Delivered value and explicit scope/boundary
        ├── Owned functional requirements
        ├── Feature-specific non-functional requirements
        ├── Applicable shared NFR references
        ├── Public contract and dependency classification
        ├── Catalogue entries / algorithms / controls delivered
        └── Acceptance oracle, target test path and evidence status
```

### 1.2 Reading and using the register

Use the feature index to find the semantic owner, then read its card and linked catalogues. Use §7 to trace a raw source ID to that owner and its refining requirement set. Use §8 for section/prose coverage and §9 for cross-feature acceptance. Before production code, propagate the selected boundary and exact public keys into the authoritative owner README/contracts through the existing feature pipeline. Compatible current implementations are adapted, not duplicated.

`REUSE_OWNER` preserves an inspected current owner identity; it does not claim all new obligations are implemented. `SELECTED_TARGET` fixes a new documentary boundary. Other source-exact labels preserve adopted specification identities. Contract files shown are **selected public targets unless the card explicitly says otherwise**; they are not an audited list of existing callable modules. All acceptance test paths and symbols below are intended deliverables, not assertions that those tests already exist.

Required edges must be available for mount/that foundational delivery. Operation-gated dependencies may be absent until an explicitly named operation is used. Later optional providers do not block a simpler useful slice. The first U milestone is not completion of every later provider expansion. Integration/task/gate links express delivery and evidence, not additional runtime imports.

### 1.3 Verification boundary

The supplied validator passes 13,474 structural invariants, including exact ownership references, nonempty acceptance links, catalogue links, source-ID counts, all56 section allocations, preserved Agentic counts, existing numeric UI identities, and an acyclic required graph. Its eight fault-injection self-tests detect deliberately broken mappings, duplicate owners, cycles and false runtime evidence.

Source extraction and semantic allocation were curated from connected GitHub reads. The complete source bytes were not mounted in the artifact runtime, so the optional independent **local source byte/ID comparison was not run**. The validator supports that comparison against the pinned checkout. Neither structural validation nor matching IDs mathematically proves that every natural-language clause is semantically satisfied; original source obligations and acceptance cells remain binding. No application tests, live trading, model evaluation or benchmarks were run.

## 3. Shared NFR register and explicit applicability

Each rule below has one governing feature and an explicit consumer set. The governor supplies the common mechanism or acceptance discipline; each consumer proves compliance in its own applicable operations. A consumer does not implement a second resource manager, security authority or canonical formula. Feature-local NFRs refine these rules without creating competing global policy.

### NFR-AGT-SECURITY

Every requirement below is owned by its enclosing feature. Catalogue entries are binding expansions of these requirements. ## 4.1. Workspace

<a id="feat-ws-manage-workspaces"></a>
### FEAT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES — Open, recover and back up a workspace

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Workspace (`D-WS`). **Identity:** `REUSE_OWNER`. **First useful slice:** U0.

**Distinct value:** A user can reopen the same workspace after a crash without losing committed metadata or artifact references.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns workspace identity, writer fencing, metadata migrations, consistent backup/restore and recovery. Does not own research qualification, domain tables, job scheduling or numerical results.

**Owning package:** `app/services/workspace/manage_workspaces`. **State ownership:** Workspace identity, writer lease and backup/recovery metadata; domain schemas remain feature-owned.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-001 | Initialize/open a workspace with one active writer fence and explicit read-only recovery mode. | AT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-001 — Two concurrent writers yield one owner and one denied/read-only session; reopening preserves the same workspace ID. |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-002 | Back up metadata and referenced immutable artifacts as one verified manifest and restore into empty staging before switching the active workspace. | AT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-002 — Corrupt one member: restore is rejected before switch; a valid restore reconciles all counts, hashes and references. |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-003 | Reconcile incomplete migration/publication records after a crash without deleting committed domain evidence. | AT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-003 — Inject crashes before promotion and after promotion/before catalogue commit; no committed row points at partial bytes and orphan custody is reported. |

#### Feature-specific non-functional requirements
| ID | Local quality / removal constraint | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NFR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-001 | Removing FEAT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES withdraws only its declared contribution; no dependent operation may silently select a substitute provider. | ATN-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES-001 — Disable and physically remove manage_workspaces; its operation is unavailable, unrelated capabilities remain usable, and retained source objects are unchanged. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Workspace (`D-WS`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U0.

**Distinct value:** Stateful features can commit and recover their own records without receiving an unrestricted database connection.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns bounded transaction/migration execution and writer fencing. A feature supplies its namespace, schema and commands; this service neither defines nor queries another feature’s business semantics.

**Owning package:** `app/services/workspace/execute_persistence`. **State ownership:** Execution/migration receipts only; no shared business CRUD namespace.

**Reconciliation note:** Selected focused boundary required by INT-PLATFORM-01. Adapt compatible existing Workspace persistence primitives; do not install a second SQLite authority.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

| FR-TRC-WS-EXECUTE_PERSISTENCE-002 | Apply ordered additive feature migration manifests with checksum verification and transactional rollback. | AT-WS-EXECUTE_PERSISTENCE-002 — Reapplying the same manifest changes nothing; changed checksum fails; a failed migration does not partially advance the schema version. |

### FEAT-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS — Publish and retain immutable artifact bytes

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Workspace (`D-WS`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U1.

**Distinct value:** Every accepted domain reference resolves verified, authorized bytes, and failed publication never masquerades as a complete result.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns staging, byte custody, content hashes, access scope, reference-aware retention and download grants. Strategy/Data/Analytics/Portfolio/Research retain artifact meaning; custody never parses SQX or computes metrics.

**Owning package:** `app/services/workspace/manage_artifacts`. **State ownership:** Artifact catalogue, custody/access/retention metadata and staging leases; immutable files remain content-addressed.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-001 | Stage, flush and validate byte count/schema declaration/content hash before atomic publication; issue a custody receipt. | AT-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-001 — A bad hash or truncated write yields no published artifact reference; retry of the same publication is idempotent. |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-002 | Resolve authorized artifact IDs and bounded download grants; reject host paths, cross-account access and expired grants. | AT-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-002 — Traversal/UNC/drive paths and a grant for another principal fail; valid downloads match the immutable checksum. |
| FR-TRC-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-003 | Retain referenced artifacts and legal holds; clean eligible staging/orphans through admitted maintenance with an audit receipt. | AT-WS-MANAGE_ARTIFACTS-003 — Deleting a databank membership leaves its referenced strategy/result bytes intact; expired unreferenced staging is removed and recorded. |

| FR-TRC-WS-SECURE_LOCAL_ACCESS-002 | Validate loopback/nonlocal host access configuration and require authenticated policy before exposing remote access. | AT-WS-SECURE_LOCAL_ACCESS-002 — An unauthenticated nonloopback configuration is rejected before listener startup; status reports no secret values. |
| FR-TRC-WS-SECURE_LOCAL_ACCESS-003 | Rotate/revoke a secret reference without rewriting historic provenance or enabling silent provider fallback. | AT-WS-SECURE_LOCAL_ACCESS-003 — An old generation loses future resolution, while historical records retain only the old opaque reference. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Catalogue (`D-CAT`). **Identity:** `REUSE_OWNER`. **First useful slice:** U2.

**Distinct value:** Costs, equity and portfolios are expressed in the intended currency using a reproducible conversion path.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns conversion topology, admissibility and exact rate/time references; Data owns observed rates and Analytics owns return metrics.

**Owning package:** `app/services/catalogue/convert_currencies`. **State ownership:** Versioned conversion policy; rate observations remain Data-owned.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |

| FR-TRC-CAT-CONVERT_CURRENCIES-001 | Resolve currency paths using only rates available by the pinned observation cutoff and expose rate/path provenance. | AT-CAT-CONVERT_CURRENCIES-001 — A future quote cannot complete a historical path; missing or stale paths return typed unavailability. |
| FR-TRC-CAT-CONVERT_CURRENCIES-002 | Apply declared scale, rounding and intermediate-range policies to conversions. | AT-CAT-CONVERT_CURRENCIES-002 — Boundary and large-notional fixtures agree with the exact Decimal oracle; overflow fails rather than wrapping or switching to float. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Strategy (`D-STRAT`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U2.

## 4.9. Orchestration

<a id="feat-orch-reserve-resources"></a>
### FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES — Admit finite work under one resource ledger

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Orchestration (`D-ORCH`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U1.

**Distinct value:** Heavy work shares host capacity without starving controls, exhausting memory or bypassing parent budgets.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns hierarchical CPU/thread/native/shared memory/I/O/disk/GPU/model reservations, queues and observed-use reconciliation. Research owns trials/holdouts; Agentic owns token/tool/mandate policy.

**Owning package:** `app/services/orchestration/reserve_resources`. **State ownership:** Resource reservations, hierarchy, fair-queue admission and reconciled usage.

**Reconciliation note:** Migrate any compatible Workspace admission behavior into this single owner with adapters/aliases, not parallel ledgers; DEC-TRC-003 records the ownership cutover.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-001 | Reserve a finite hierarchical resource profile for every heavy operation and reject/queue impossible requests before allocation. | AT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-001 — A child job cannot reserve its parent’s capacity again; missing or negative caps do not mean unlimited permission. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-002 | Enforce the source workstation defaults: 70% memory envelope, 85%/95% pressure actions, reserved control CPUs, 256 ready descriptors, two prefetch chunks, 64 MiB buffers, 20% cache ceiling and one compile job. | AT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-002 — Mixed-load fixtures cannot exceed combined runnable-thread or memory reservations; unknown estimates carry hard caps and visible capacity outcomes. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-003 | Budget temporary disk as min(16 GiB,25% free) at initialization and preserve at least 10% free space; reconcile actual native/shared/device use. | AT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-003 — A new write is denied before violating disk headroom; shared resident pages are not double-counted and Python heap alone is not treated as total memory. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-004 | Provide fair queues with bounded aging and reserved interactive/cancellation capacity; existing safety-critical execution keeps priority. | AT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-004 — Under BM-APP-01 bulk work cannot suppress control acknowledgement or disable risk/broker serialization checks. |

#### Feature-specific non-functional requirements
| ID | Local quality / removal constraint | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NFR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-001 | Resource accounting covers native allocations, unique resident shared pages, mappings, caches, decode/output buffers and VRAM, not only Python allocations. | ATN-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-001 — Larger-than-RAM and mixed-load measurements stay inside the effective global and per-operation caps. |
| NFR-TRC-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-002 | Control latency and cancellation capacity remain reserved while bulk work is admitted. | ATN-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES-002 — BM-APP-01 meets warm local metadata/control p95 ≤250 ms and p99 ≤1 s; over-capacity bulk work is visibly queued/refused. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Orchestration (`D-ORCH`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U1.

**Distinct value:** Accepted work survives browser closure and process restart with one authoritative lifecycle and explainable attempts.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns job admission/enqueue, infrastructure states, attempts, cancel/pause/resume transport and parent-child lineage. Domain owners retain semantic outcomes and acceptance decisions.

**Owning package:** `app/services/orchestration/manage_jobs`. **State ownership:** Shared jobs, enqueue/outbox intents, attempt history, parent-child lineage and desired/acknowledged controls.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-001 | Persist accepted immutable job/input identity and enqueue intent atomically before reporting acceptance. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-001 — A crash after the response but before dispatch still leaves one resolvable job; replaying the same logical request does not enqueue another. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-002 | Apply expected-version lifecycle transitions and provider-declared checkpoint pause/resume; terminal retry creates a linked new attempt/run. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-002 — Completion-versus-stop races yield one terminal result; unsupported pause is rejected rather than inferred from silence. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-003 | Record domain outcome separately from worker status, including Agentic REFUSED over successful worker completion and human waits without held worker slots. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-003 — UI inspection can distinguish successful refusal from successful research; an expired wait does not fabricate an active worker. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-004 | Reconcile uncertain receiver effects by original idempotency key before retry and bound nesting/ancestry. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS-004 — Crash after receiver commit produces one accepted logical effect; recursive ancestor submission is denied. |

<a id="feat-orch-manage-remote-workers"></a>
### FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS — Lease and reconcile authenticated remote work

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Orchestration (`D-ORCH`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U12.

**Distinct value:** A distributed pool can retry computation after partitions without accepting duplicate results or changing deterministic reduction order.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns worker registration/health, authenticated lease/heartbeat/fencing, drain/quarantine and remote completion arbitration. UI never contacts workers directly; no second scheduler.

**Owning package:** `app/services/orchestration/manage_remote_workers`. **State ownership:** Worker identities/capacity/health, fencing leases, remote attempts and arbitration receipts.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS-001 | Register authenticated workers with capacity, operations and runtime/numerical compatibility; admit only healthy compatible providers. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS-001 — Unknown/revoked identities or incompatible numerical fingerprints receive no lease; draining/offline/quarantined nodes get no new work. |
| FR-TRC-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS-002 | Issue monotonically fenced leases with initial heartbeat 5 s, lease 30 s and at most two retries after the initial attempt. | AT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS-002 — A partition can duplicate computation but only one current logical completion is accepted; stale tokens cannot replace it. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Simulator (`D-SIM`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U2.

**Distinct value:** Every simulation consumes the selected method’s complete event stream with truthful evidence class and ordering.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns TickMethodSpec, generated-path semantics, deterministic source merge, event ordering and TickStreamManifest. Data owns recorded observations; a benchmark generator is not a production market model.

**Owning package:** `app/services/simulator/model_ticks`. **State ownership:** Tick-method descriptors and immutable stream manifests; scoped merge/generator cursors.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-001 | Implement recorded replay and generated replay as registered methods with versioned algorithm/configuration, source, seed, density/timing/path/spread/gap/quantization policy. | AT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-001 — Generated methods cannot activate without a complete algorithm artifact and goldens; no unrequested method is selected by default. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-002 | Preserve source sequence and use a pinned equal-time cross-source/timer ordering; finalize half-open bars before the next interval’s observations. | AT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-002 — Equal-time groups split across chunks and multi-timeframe close boundaries produce identical event order and available-bar snapshots. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-003 | Count/hash actual emitted and consumed observations and expose partial coverage on cancellation. | AT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-003 — Source/emitted/consumed counters reconcile; thinning ticks, shortening history or substituting an OHLC collision rule fails acceptance. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-004 | Expose only the generated path prefix to strategy state and reject recorded-microstructure nodes on incompatible methods. | AT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS-004 — A strategy cannot read the future source bar’s final high/low before simulated closure; last-only feeds never gain fabricated bid/ask evidence. |

### FEAT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS — Execute the native chronological backtest

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Simulator (`D-SIM`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U2.

**Distinct value:** A saved strategy is evaluated with tick-level fills, protective exits, cash, positions and valuation without interpreter-loop bottlenecks or changed semantics.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns the native execution loop, order/fill/event state and checkpoint recovery. It consumes Strategy plans and owner-qualified numerical policies; it neither calls an LLM nor obtains live broker authority.

**Owning package:** `app/services/simulator/execute_ticks`. **State ownership:** Owner execution state/checkpoints and append-only order/fill facts; native buffers scoped to a pinned provider generation.

**Delivery increments:** U2 core order/exit engine; U10 declared partial-close/scale-in-out and extended action providers.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-001 | Lower the target-neutral plan into typed instruction/operand/parameter/state buffers and execute all eligible events in a compiled nopython loop. | AT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-001 — Compiled-signature/profile checks show no per-tick Pydantic, dictionary traversal, pandas row iteration, capability resolution, SQL, SSE or model call. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-002 | Process quote update → previously active orders/exits → accounting/causal indicators → subscribed rules → future eligible intents in the pinned order. | AT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-002 — A new intent cannot fill on its decision tick; market/stop gaps/limit-or-better/pending expiry/replace/netting/hedging/trailing/time-exit fixtures match the reference. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-003 | Preserve exact money/quantity atoms, checked intermediates and declared Float64 tolerances with fastmath=False. | AT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-003 — Overflow and nonrepresentable scales produce typed diagnostics or preselected qualified wider arithmetic; no wrapping or binary-float money fallback occurs. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-004 | Carry full positions/orders/cash/exposure/rolling bars/quotes/timers/callbacks/PRNG/cursors/subphase and committed output parts across slices/checkpoints. | AT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-004 — Restart and OUTPUT_FULL replay neither duplicate fills nor warm up/reset the strategy per chunk; incompatible hashes/runtime checkpoints fail. |
| FR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-005 | Execute all single/Builder/Retester/parameter/WF/portfolio/AI simulation callers through this same selected-method contract. | AT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-005 — Caller integration fixtures expose no separate reduced-fidelity engine, private sibling import or unaccounted trial. |

#### Feature-specific non-functional requirements
| ID | Local quality / removal constraint | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NFR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-001 | Use at most 65,536 events per native slice, further bounded by bytes and adaptation toward a 100 ms slice budget. | ATN-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-001 — Complex-plan cancellation reaches quiescence p95 ≤2 s and retains the exact next event/subphase. |
| NFR-TRC-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-002 | Meet qualified native comparator and scale gates without changing workload or output obligations. | ATN-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS-002 — PERF-G01–G04: exact/tolerance equivalence; warm compute ≤1.5× and same-harness full run ≤2× C++ comparator; 10× fixed-state input costs ≤12× compute; every 20-year method meets its pre-frozen absolute budget. |

| FR-TRC-SIM-SIMULATE_STOCKPICKERS-002 | Execute interacting capital, cross-symbol signals and order state in one chronological tick run. | AT-SIM-SIMULATE_STOCKPICKERS-002 — Independent-symbol summation is rejected when shared cash/risk/positions alter execution; constituent and combined lineage is retained. |

### FEAT-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES — Construct random and seeded valid candidates

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Research (`D-RES`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U5.

**Distinct value:** Builder produces reproducible typed strategies from an accepted space without modifying parents or generating illegal programs.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns Full/Grow/ramped-half-and-half sampling and seeded retain/extend/regenerate construction. Strategy owns grammar/templates/validation; execution and ranking remain separate.

**Owning package:** `app/services/research/generate_strategies`. **State ownership:** Generator plans/checkpoints, candidate lineage and bounded construction-attempt history.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

| FR-TRC-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-001 | Generate bounded candidates from weighted enabled blocks and typed depth/node/lookback/parameter/lock constraints using pinned PRNG streams. | AT-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-001 — Impossible grammar/depth returns unsatisfied constraints within the attempt budget; no circular or invalid accepted tree is generated. |
| FR-TRC-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-002 | Implement Full/Grow/ramped-half-and-half and explicit seeded retain/replace/extend behavior with immutable parent provenance. | AT-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-002 — Fixed seed yields the same population/lineage; locked subtrees and parent bytes remain unchanged. |
| FR-TRC-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-003 | Apply static validation and safe identity dedup before evaluation, retaining separate AST-attempt and fully evaluated counters. | AT-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES-003 — A rejected duplicate or invalid AST does not masquerade as a completed simulation or a passing decimation candidate. |

<a id="feat-res-evolve-strategies"></a>
### FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES — Evolve bounded island populations

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Research (`D-RES`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U5.

**Distinct value:** Builder searches structural strategy variants with deterministic operators, migration and restarts whose costs remain visible.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns evolutionary population transitions and operator traces. Strategy owns semantic compatibility; Research run/fitness owners supply evaluation/ranking; worker arrival never supplies randomness.

**Owning package:** `app/services/research/evolve_strategies`. **State ownership:** Population generations/islands, operator/seed provenance, checkpoint and all evaluation receipts.

**Delivery increments:** U5 baseline island operators; U10 rank/roulette and real-valued/Pareto/diversity extensions.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-001 | Initialize K×M×N unique filter-passing fully evaluated candidates, rank them and allocate M×N survivors by deterministic round-robin. | AT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-001 — Insufficient eligible candidates returns INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATES with counts; raw AST attempts and duplicates do not satisfy the target. |
| FR-TRC-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-002 | Apply tournament-without-replacement selection, immutable elites, type/unit/clock-compatible one/two-point crossover and bounded mutation respecting locks. | AT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-002 — Two crossover points are disjoint; a missing compatible swap yields a recorded bounded no-op/retry, never an invalid child. |
| FR-TRC-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-003 | Run elite → offspring/evaluation → rank → simultaneous directed-ring migration → duplicate/refill → fresh blood → checkpoint/termination. | AT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-003 — Migration takes floor(N×rate), including zero; arrival order cannot alter replacements, and elite/finite budget constraints survive restarts. |
| FR-TRC-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-004 | Use versioned Mersenne Twister state and SHA-256 length-prefixed seed derivation over purpose/generation/island/candidate/operator/attempt. | AT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-004 — Changing worker count/schedule does not change candidate identity, operator stream or tie-breaks; restart restores the exact PRNG state. |
| FR-TRC-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-005 | Add U10 rank/roulette, real crossover/Gaussian/polynomial/SBX and structure/phenotype diversity as registered operators with explicit equations/parameters. | AT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES-005 — All-zero roulette scores use a recorded uniform warning; Gaussian snapping ties go to the lower legal lattice index; undefined operators are unavailable, not substituted. |

### FEAT-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES — Apply hard eligibility and versioned fitness selection

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Research (`D-RES`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U5.

**Distinct value:** A high score cannot hide a failed rule, undefined metric or contaminated sample, and every selection decision is explainable.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns hard-filter application, normalized scalar/weighted/Pareto ranking and stable tie-breaks. Analytics owns numerical metrics; Research protocols own sample/holdout restrictions.

**Owning package:** `app/services/research/rank_candidates`. **State ownership:** Ranking/filter policy revisions and selection artifacts.

**Delivery increments:** U5 scalar/weighted ranking and filters; U10 Pareto/NSGA-II and advanced selection/diversity providers.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-001 | Apply versioned metric/sample/operator/threshold/unit/null hard rules before fitness and retain every dismissal reason. | AT-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-001 — An undefined required metric fails eligibility even when another objective is high; zero-trade candidates are rejected where the declared protocol requires it. |
| FR-TRC-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-002 | Rank scalar or weighted normalized metrics with nonnegative weights summing to one and development-fitted transforms. | AT-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-002 — Raw currency profit, Sharpe and drawdown percent are not added without normalization; final OOS cannot fit a transform. |
| FR-TRC-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-003 | Implement U10 Pareto/NSGA-II fronts and crowding with direction normalization, undefined exclusion and stable hash ties. | AT-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES-003 — Dominance is no-worse in every objective and strictly-better in one; equal/zero-range columns contribute zero crowding span. |

**Distinct value:** A candidate passes only its recorded research policy, with full limitations and no implied live approval.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns final research qualification, robustness/WF stability decisions and promotion prerequisites. It consumes evidence, never changes metrics, holdouts or Risk authority to manufacture a pass.

<a id="feat-res-infer-models"></a>
### FEAT-RES-INFER_MODELS — Execute qualified lightweight model inference

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Research (`D-RES`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U11.

**Distinct value:** A strategy evaluates a pinned model without loading a heavyweight training framework in each tick loop.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns safe numeric model loading and authoritative inference kernels/sequence state. Strategy owns the HSL model node and source generation; the browser never executes authoritative inference.

**Owning package:** `app/services/research/infer_models`. **State ownership:** Scoped loaded safe tensors/sequence state and bounded kernel cache; model packages are immutable.

**Reconciliation note:** Model package qualification is an operation acceptance prerequisite, not a required mount dependency on training/validation. This avoids Simulator ↔ model-validation cycles. “Zero dependency” is interpreted as no PyTorch/TensorFlow training runtime, not no NumPy/native dependency.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-RES-INFER_MODELS-001 | Load only safe declared graph/tensor formats with immutable model/preprocessing hashes, ordered inputs and supported operators. | AT-RES-INFER_MODELS-001 — Unknown operator/dtype or malformed weights fail preflight; arbitrary Python/Java object deserialization is impossible. |
| FR-TRC-RES-INFER_MODELS-002 | Implement qualified feedforward NumPy/native inference and compatible causal sequence kernels with explicit reset, normalization, activation and output semantics. | AT-RES-INFER_MODELS-002 — Golden predictions on normal/boundary/missing/sequence-reset vectors match authoritative inference within recorded tolerances; no unconditional ReLU/class-order substitution occurs. |
| FR-TRC-RES-INFER_MODELS-003 | Apply the versioned classification decision policy: initial directional max probability must exceed 0.55, otherwise neutral; ties are neutral. | AT-RES-INFER_MODELS-003 — A tied maximum or probability exactly 0.55 yields neutral; changing threshold/class order creates a new policy/package revision. |

| ID | Local quality / removal constraint | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NFR-TRC-RES-INFER_MODELS-001 | Removing FEAT-RES-INFER_MODELS withdraws only its declared contribution; no dependent operation may silently select a substitute provider. | ATN-RES-INFER_MODELS-001 — Disable and physically remove infer_models; its operation is unavailable, unrelated capabilities remain usable, and retained source objects are unchanged. |

### FEAT-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS — Search typed parameter spaces and preserve every trial

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Optimization (`D-OPT`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U6.

**Distinct value:** A user can run exact-grid, discrete-genetic or sequential-coordinate optimization with transparent scale and complete accounting.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns parameter enumeration/search mechanics, trial/result ledger, checkpoints and surfaces. Research owns protocol/holdout/qualification; no dependency on Builder implementation is required.

**Owning package:** `app/services/optimization/search_parameters`. **State ownership:** Search plans, every trial/attempt/result and immutable surface artifacts.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-001 | Build legal parameter lattices from typed bounds/step/options/dependencies and count Cartesian combinations with arbitrary-precision integers before allocation. | AT-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-001 — Floating cardinality errors do not add/drop a legal value; invalid dependent parameters fail instead of coercing. |
| FR-TRC-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-002 | Execute grid, discrete evolutionary and ordered coordinate-search providers through the same immutable simulation request contract. | AT-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-002 — Sequential search records parameter order, fixed values, passes/tolerance and hash ties; mutation resamples legal indexes only. |
| FR-TRC-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-003 | Generate work lazily, reuse compiled topology/immutable data, and retain active/completed/failed/cancelled/invalid/refused/pruned/cache-hit trial outcomes with actual costs. | AT-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-003 — At least 1,000 requests do not allocate a whole Cartesian product or JIT per tuple; pruning is incomplete evidence with a protocol reason. |
| FR-TRC-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-004 | Persist complete parameter/metric/sample/state surfaces under declared retention and promote selected tuples only through a new Strategy revision. | AT-OPT-SEARCH_PARAMETERS-004 — A best point does not overwrite its source strategy; sampled display surfaces disclose omitted/retained counts. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Agentic (`D-AGT`). **Identity:** `SPEC_EXACT_FEATURE`. **First useful slice:** U2.

**Distinct value:** Accept a fresh bounded Interfaces-validated workspace snapshot and verify principal/account/widget/generation/time/hash/redaction.

**Scope and boundary:** Stateless conversational coordination; Workspace owns transcript and workflow/claim owners retain canonical results. All receiver interactions use public contracts and exact governance; no private sibling imports.

**Owning package:** `app/services/agentic/assist_operator`. **State ownership:** None. Immutable outputs use workflow artifact operations/calling owner and Workspace custody; no private durable namespace.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-AGT-READ_WORKSPACE_CONTEXT | Accept a fresh bounded Interfaces-validated workspace snapshot and verify principal/account/widget/generation/time/hash/redaction. | AT-AGT-ASSIST_OPERATOR-001 — Cross-user/account, expired, unknown/removed widget, oversized or secret-bearing context fails; every message gets a new snapshot. |
| FR-AGT-ANSWER_CONTEXTUAL_QUESTIONS | Answer safe UI meaning, definitions, navigation and already grounded summaries without domain mutation. | AT-AGT-ASSIST_OPERATOR-002 — A material price/metric/run claim requires owner refresh and a suitable specialist, not browser text or model invention. |

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / Interfaces (`D-IFACE`). **Identity:** `REUSE_OWNER`. **First useful slice:** U13.

**Distinct value:** External clients invoke the same governed owner capabilities and receive truthful typed outcomes without recreating business logic.

<a id="feat-ui-performance-lab"></a>
### FEAT-UI-PERFORMANCE_LAB — Inspect reproducible performance and lifecycle evidence

**Product / domain:** HaruQuantAI V3 / UI (`D-UI`). **Identity:** `SELECTED_TARGET`. **First useful slice:** U10.

**Distinct value:** A developer can compare measured workloads and UI churn without mistaking targets or cache hits for real speed evidence.

**Scope and boundary:** Owns only the named removable presentation/interaction. Uses generated typed clients, stable references and owner-authored values; no business calculation, private service import, SQL, credentials or hidden multi-step workflow.

**Owning package:** `app/ui/src/widgets/performance-lab`. **State ownership:** Versioned display preferences and unsaved typed draft only; never canonical business data.

**Delivery increments:** First delivery names the earliest useful scope. Later catalogue/provider expansions retain the same feature identity and must meet their own U10–U13 or specified source milestone gates before being advertised.

#### Owned functional requirements
| ID | Binding behavior | Acceptance ID / expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-TRC-UI-PERFORMANCE_LAB-001 | Run the developer-only deterministic grid operation stream with insert 20 ms/remove 30 ms/update 40 ms and at most ten visual batches per second. | AT-UI-PERFORMANCE_LAB-001 — Simulated-clock replay gives identical selection/operation order; stop/unmount leaves no timer/listener/worker/request. |
| FR-TRC-UI-PERFORMANCE_LAB-002 | Inspect matched benchmark reports with source/emitted/consumed ticks, tick-strategy evaluations, outputs, cache/cold/warm and stage time/memory/copy/I/O distinctions. | AT-UI-PERFORMANCE_LAB-002 — A target without a measurement or a mismatched fixture cannot be marked passed; throughput excludes exact result-cache hits. |

| CAT-GENETIC-002 — Construction defaults | [FEAT-RES-GENERATE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-generate-strategies) | Ramped half-and-half; depth 2..6; maximum 128 nodes; Full/Grow obey typed grammar and locked sections. |
| CAT-GENETIC-003 — Selection | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Tournament size 3, supported 2..7; selection probability 0.80 with remainder assigned to the last ranked entrant; without-replacement draws. |
| CAT-GENETIC-004 — Variation/elite | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Crossover 0.70; mutation 0.20; one crossover point by default, one/two disjoint supported; elite count 1. |
| CAT-GENETIC-005 — Decimation | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | K=2, valid finite 1..10; seek K×M×N unique eligible fully evaluated candidates; no raw-attempt shortcut. |
| CAT-GENETIC-006 — Migration | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Every 5 generations; rate 0.10, maximum 0.20; directed ring with simultaneous snapshots and floor(N×rate) migrants. |
| CAT-GENETIC-007 — Fresh blood | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Fraction 0.10 every 5 generations, maximum 0.30; replace weakest eligible non-elites under the same validation/budget policy. |
| CAT-GENETIC-008 — Stagnation and restarts | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | 10-generation threshold, minimum 3; tolerance 1e-8; restart true, finish-on-stagnation false; maximum 2 restarts; immutable elites preserved. |
| CAT-GENETIC-009 — Hard search limits | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Maximum 100,000 evaluations and 3,600 seconds in the template; explicit seed; joint population/work/byte budgets validated before admission. |
| CAT-GENETIC-010 — PRNG and child identity | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Versioned Mersenne Twister state; SHA-256 over unambiguous length-prefixed master-seed/purpose/generation/island/candidate/operator/attempt tuple; first 128 big-endian bits seed child streams. |
| CAT-GENETIC-011 — Generation transition | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Elite → offspring construction/evaluation → rank → simultaneous ring migration → duplicate/refill → fresh blood → checkpoint/stop; worker arrival cannot choose random or tie order. |
| CAT-GENETIC-012 — Structural crossover | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Only type/unit/clock/lookback/template-lock-compatible subtrees; two chosen points cannot overlap; bounded failure yields recorded no-op/retry. |
| CAT-GENETIC-013 — Mutation | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Subtree replacement, compatible node replacement, inversion, parameter resampling and legal discrete steps; immutable parents and locked subtrees. |
| CAT-GENETIC-014 — Advanced selection/variation U10 | [FEAT-RES-EVOLVE_STRATEGIES](#feat-res-evolve-strategies) | Rank/roulette with explicit nonnegative transforms and all-zero uniform warning; uniform/arithmetic/SBX/real/ Gaussian/polynomial operators with published parameters and legal-domain projection. |
| CAT-GENETIC-015 — Hard filtering and scalar fitness | [FEAT-RES-RANK_CANDIDATES](#feat-res-rank-candidates) | Hard predicates precede fitness; undefined required metric fails. Weighted normalized nonnegative weights sum to one; transform fit uses development support only. |

### CAT-HSL — Canonical language semantics and authoring controls

**Source:** §14, §37, §42.7, §47.5, §47.6. **Qualification:** REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_EVIDENCE. All item evidence is PENDING.

| Entry ID / name | Accountable feature | Binding delivery / acceptance obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CAT-HSL-001 — Document identity | [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast) | language=hsl; version=2.0.0; schema=hsl://schema/strategy/2.0.0; exactly one production canonical node-store language. |
| CAT-HSL-002 — Type system | [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast) | Scalar kind, unit, nullability, series item type; Boolean/PriceLevel/PriceDelta/OscillatorLevel/Volume/BarShift/Duration/Symbol/Direction/Size/OrderIntent distinctions. |
| CAT-HSL-003 — Node/graph model | [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast) | Stable node IDs; VALUE/EXPRESSION/CONDITION/STATEMENT/ACTION discriminators; registry-backed block/version; typed inputs/arguments; acyclic references where required. |
| CAT-HSL-004 — Numbers and invalid arithmetic | [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast) | Decimal/public exact money; native scaled atoms with overflow bounds; Float64 indicators; no NaN-as-price; missing/invalid results use explicit masks/diagnostics. |
| CAT-HSL-005 — Boolean and crossings | [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast) | Ordered three-valued short-circuit semantics; strict cross requires strict inequalities outside the equality band at both relevant samples. |
| CAT-HSL-006 — Chart roles | [FEAT-STRAT-CONFIGURE_CHARTS](#feat-strat-configure-charts) | One PRIMARY; ordered SECONDARY/ORDER_TARGET; exact instrument/profile/session/calendar/timeframe/shift/warm-up references. |
| CAT-HSL-007 — Events | [FEAT-STRAT-CONFIGURE_CHARTS](#feat-strat-configure-charts) | ON_INIT/ON_BAR_CLOSE/ON_BAR_OPEN/ON_TICK/ON_POSITION_OPEN/ON_POSITION_CLOSE/ON_DEINIT; init/deinit cannot submit executable orders. |
| CAT-HSL-008 — Availability at boundaries | [FEAT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS](#feat-sim-model-ticks) | Half-open bars; all timeframes closing at the instant visible together before next-bar observations; generated path prefix only. |
| CAT-HSL-009 — Pending-order validity | [FEAT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS](#feat-sim-execute-ticks) | Market next eligible tick; stops gap to first executable quote; limit fills no worse than the limit; N-bar validity expires after N subsequent completed bars with creation bar numbered zero. |
| CAT-HSL-010 — Protection/management | [FEAT-STRAT-MODEL_ATM_EXITS](#feat-strat-model-atm-exits) | Disabled/fixed/percent/ATR/formula/absolute SL/PT; break-even/trailing/holding-bar/session exits; typed rounding/activation/ratchet/scope. |
| CAT-HSL-011 — Partial/reverse extensions | [FEAT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS](#feat-sim-execute-ticks) | Legal down-quantized partial quantity; zero/over-close rejection; reverse closes first and validates any opposite entry separately; explicit netting/hedging. |
| CAT-HSL-012 — Parameters and variables | [FEAT-STRAT-VERSION_STRATEGIES](#feat-strat-version-strategies) | Identity/name/type/default/external/optimizable/bounds/step/options/formula/dependencies; runtime variables have separate update/reset rules. |
| CAT-HSL-013 — Symmetry | [FEAT-STRAT-EDIT_TEMPLATES](#feat-strat-edit-templates) | Descriptor-declared side/band/relational/offset changes; RSI30→70, stochastic20→80, CCI−100→100 and Williams%R−80→−20 only under their declared reflection semantics. |
| CAT-HSL-014 — Review and revision | [FEAT-STRAT-VERSION_STRATEGIES](#feat-strat-version-strategies) | Base revision/content hash, ordered patch operations, affected nodes/paths, assumptions, dependency closure and recomputed final review hash. |

<a id="cat-metrics"></a>
### CAT-METRICS — Metric definitions and numerical acceptance families

**Source:** §9.3, §10, §26.3, §36.7, §56.8. **Qualification:** REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_EVIDENCE. All item evidence is PENDING.

| Entry ID / name | Accountable feature | Binding delivery / acceptance obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CAT-METRICS-001 — Net profit | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Sum canonical net trade outcomes with commission/swap once; slippage already reflected in fills is not subtracted a second time; currency and sample fixed. |
| CAT-METRICS-002 — Gross profit/loss and Profit Factor | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Positive/negative net trade sums; PF = positive sum / abs(negative sum); zero-loss denominator undefined. |
| CAT-METRICS-003 — Trade count/win rate/expectancy/payoff | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Closed/partial/zero trades, sample, denominators and cost convention explicit; no universal inferred null policy. |
| CAT-METRICS-004 — Equity/balance drawdown | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Running-peak amount/percent with declared balance/equity/open-P&L basis; percent requires positive peak; duration uses pinned market/calendar clock. |
| CAT-METRICS-005 — CAGR | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Positive eligible cashflow-adjusted beginning/ending value and elapsed-year convention; nonpositive/invalid durations undefined. |
| CAT-METRICS-006 — Sharpe | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Mean excess periodic return / sample standard deviation × sqrt(declared calendar frequency); at least two periods and nonzero dispersion. |
| CAT-METRICS-007 — Sortino | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Explicit MAR, downside definition, sample and annualization; missing/zero downside handling declared before column activation. |
| CAT-METRICS-008 — Calmar | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Same-convention CAGR / maximum equity drawdown; invalid/zero denominator unavailable. |
| CAT-METRICS-009 — SQN | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | sqrt(N) × mean R / sample standard deviation R; R requires valid initial risk and nonzero dispersion. |
| CAT-METRICS-010 — Return/drawdown | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Numerator and denominator share money/currency/sample basis; no automatic mixing of profit money and drawdown percent. |
| CAT-METRICS-011 — Ulcer/stagnation/recovery | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Versioned period sampling, drawdown basis, duration and insufficient-history semantics. |
| CAT-METRICS-012 — Exposure/margin/leverage | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Defined positions, clock, capital basis, currency conversion and weighting; no downsampled shortcut to tick-sensitive maxima. |
| CAT-METRICS-013 — MAE/MFE | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Actual retained execution/market path and declared price-side/units/rounding; not reconstructible from a downsampled plot or absent data. |
| CAT-METRICS-014 — Pips/points/R/money/percent | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Distinct unit families with explicit instrument scales and basis; unsupported conversion remains unavailable. |
| CAT-METRICS-015 — Period/long-short/sample splits | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Shared formula definition applied to exact scoped populations and calendars, not recomputed by UI. |
| CAT-METRICS-016 — Distribution/tails/ruin/stress | [FEAT-ANA-COMPUTE_METRICS](#feat-ana-compute-metrics) | Explicit estimator, seed, resampling/scenario assumptions, population, support, confidence and undefined cases; no universal profit claim. |
| CAT-METRICS-017 — Correlation/covariance | [FEAT-POR-ANALYZE_CORRELATION](#feat-por-analyze-correlation) | Portfolio-owned aligned-return definition; Pearson at least two pairs and nonzero variance; missingness/negative policy explicit. |
| CAT-METRICS-018 — Diversification ratio | [FEAT-POR-ANALYZE_PORTFOLIO_RISK](#feat-por-analyze-portfolio-risk) | For declared long-only policy: weighted standalone volatility divided by portfolio volatility; zero denominator unavailable; not the same as Sharpe difference. |

### CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS — Worker protocol and three-grid telemetry

**Source:** §40.1, §40.3, §40.8. **Qualification:** REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_EVIDENCE. All item evidence is PENDING.

| Entry ID / name | Accountable feature | Binding delivery / acceptance obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-001 — Worker lifecycle | [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS](#feat-orch-manage-remote-workers) | REGISTERED/HEALTHY/DRAINING/OFFLINE/QUARANTINED; authenticated principal, compatibility, heartbeat and authorized recovery. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-002 — HTTP worker operations | [FEAT-IFACE-OPERATE_JOBS](#feat-iface-operate-jobs) | POST /api/v1/grid/workers/register; POST /api/v1/grid/tasks/acquire; POST /api/v1/grid/tasks/{task_id}/heartbeat; POST /api/v1/grid/tasks/{task_id}/complete; GET /api/v1/grid/status; typed owner operations, HTTP/SSE snapshots. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-003 — inProgressGrid | [FEAT-UI-RUN_MONITOR](#feat-ui-run-monitor) | Task ID/client IP/host/job-strategy/status/elapsed/progress/estimated remaining; estimates and unknown progress explicitly labelled. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-004 — waitingGrid | [FEAT-UI-RUN_MONITOR](#feat-ui-run-monitor) | Queue position/priority/symbol/timeframe/engine type/submitted timestamp from shared Orchestration state. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-005 — finishedGrid | [FEAT-UI-RUN_MONITOR](#feat-ui-run-monitor) | Task/host/completion/duration/generated count/best fitness/peak memory from actual immutable attempts and results. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-006 — Remote benchmark evidence | [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics) | RTT <15 ms LAN/<80 ms WAN and >500 tests/sec/core are source targets only on a pinned declared workload; no unqualified universal throughput claim. |
| CAT-WORKER-CONTROLS-007 — Health versus lease expiry | [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS](#feat-orch-manage-remote-workers) | Three missed 5-second heartbeats can trigger declared quarantine/admission control; 30-second fencing lease remains independently authoritative for completion. |

<a id="cat-resource-limits"></a>
### CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS — Finite baseline admission and numerical slicing controls

**Source:** §56.6, §56.10. **Qualification:** REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_EVIDENCE. All item evidence is PENDING.

| Entry ID / name | Accountable feature | Binding delivery / acceptance obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-001 — Host memory envelope | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | At most 70% effective physical/container RAM, narrowed by configured byte cap; private/native/shared resident/mapping/cache/buffer use included. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-002 — Memory pressure actions | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | At 85% of application envelope stop bulk admission and evict unpinned cache; at 95% bounded checkpoint/cancel/reduce concurrency; enforce hard envelope. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-003 — Effective CPU capacity | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | Respect quota/affinity; reserve two logical CPUs at four or more, one on smaller hosts when possible; one-CPU host serializes bulk work with bounded slices. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-004 — Native thread budget | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | One compute thread per independent tick worker by default; explicit BLAS/Numba/Arrow/query reservations prevent nested all-core selection. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-005 — Ready work and prefetch | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | At most 256 ready descriptors; two prefetched chunks per reader; remaining work remains a lazy durable plan. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-006 — Buffers/cache | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | At most 64 MiB per input/output buffer, narrowed by reservation/event/time limits; shared cache at most 20% application envelope; pinned mappings counted. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-007 — Compile and temporary disk | [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources) | One compilation per host by default; finite temp disk ≤ min(16 GiB,25% free at initialization); preserve ≥10% free and recheck before writes. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-008 — Progress coalescing | [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS](#feat-orch-manage-jobs) | At most two ordinary compute progress publications/s/run by default; bounded terminal/error/control signals are immediate. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-009 — Native slice | [FEAT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS](#feat-sim-execute-ticks) | At most 65,536 events, further byte/time limited and adapt downward toward 100 ms; OUTPUT_FULL preserves event/subphase and cannot duplicate a fill. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-010 — Storage baseline | [FEAT-DATA-MARKET_DATA_STORE](#feat-data-market-data-store) | Partitioned immutable Parquet Zstandard level3; initial target ~128 MiB uncompressed row groups narrowed by memory; measured profile changes versioned. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-011 — Chat input limits | [FEAT-AGT-ASSIST_OPERATOR](#feat-agt-assist-operator) | 16,000 message characters;32 contributions;128 KiB snapshot;30s TTL;four delegates/turn;two candidate repairs; stricter mandate/provider envelope wins. |
| CAT-RESOURCE-LIMITS-012 — Remote lease defaults | [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS](#feat-orch-manage-remote-workers) | Authenticated heartbeat every5s;30s lease;at most two retry attempts after initial; exact monotonic fencing and compatible checkpoints. |

## 6. Integration workflows and role ownership

These connect feature capabilities; they are not additional features. A feature remains independently removable while any workflow requiring it becomes explicitly unavailable. Registered roles remain disabled/ineligible until their exact policy/profile evidence permits invocation.

## 9. Performance, release and implementation-task traceability

Benchmark harnesses, source task IDs and acceptance gates are **not** additional runtime features. Their owners deliver the implementation or evidence. No benchmark or gate below has been run by this documentation task.

**Hardware:** Primary Windows x86-64, ≥8 physical cores,32 GiBRAM,localNVMe; secondary8 logical CPUs/16GiB. Exact machine/OS/power/runtime/toolchain/profile fingerprints must be recorded.

**Repetitions:** At least5 measured normal/scale repetitions after warm-up; at least3 long20Y repeats. Percentiles unsupported by the sample size remain unavailable.

**Comparators:** Independent Python/Decimal correctness oracle and optimized same-work C++ benchmark comparator; C++ is test tooling, not a second production engine.

**Timing:** Separate compilation/startup/cache-load/data-read/decode/generation/native-compute/output/hash/verification/full-run stages; exact result-cache hits excluded from fresh-simulation throughput.

**Safety:** No live accounts, paid models or unauthorized data required in ordinary acceptance fixtures; real-provider qualification is separate and explicitly configured.

## 10. Resolved ambiguities and evidence dependencies

### TRD-001 — Preserve current feature identities

**Owners:** [FEAT-UI-01](#feat-ui-01), [FEAT-DATA-INGEST_HISTORY](#feat-data-ingest-history), [FEAT-PLUG-REGISTER_CONTRIBUTIONS](#feat-plug-register-contributions). **Source:** §21.2, §22, §25.

Use current domain/feature/entry-point identities where inspected; numeric UI IDs are permanent. The stale services master registry and prior DAG nodes are not the new feature count. A new leaf extraction must update its owner README and preserve existing UI behavior/aliases before code.

### TRD-002 — One shared scheduler and resource ledger

**Owners:** [FEAT-ORCH-RESERVE_RESOURCES](#feat-orch-reserve-resources), [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_JOBS](#feat-orch-manage-jobs), [FEAT-ORCH-EXECUTE_LOCAL_WORK](#feat-orch-execute-local-work), [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS](#feat-orch-manage-remote-workers), [FEAT-WS-MANAGE_WORKSPACES](#feat-ws-manage-workspaces). **Source:** §41, §42.4, §56.10.

Orchestration owns admission/jobs/workers/project attempts. Adapt/rehome compatible older Workspace worker/runtime behavior; Workspace retains settings, identity, storage and custody. No parallel authoritative ledger.

### TRD-003 — One HSL language and honest XML conversion

**Owners:** [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast), [FEAT-STRAT-IMPORT_SQX](#feat-strat-import-sqx), [FEAT-STRAT-COMPILE_STRATEGIES](#feat-strat-compile-strategies). **Source:** §37.9, §42.7.

Canonical language is hsl 2.0.0, schema hsl://schema/strategy/2.0.0 and §42.7 root/node-store. The flat §37.9 JSON is an adapter intermediate/golden mapping, not a second production schema. Preserve every listed source field through typed conversion and loss reporting.

### TRD-004 — Manifest-backed contributions, not import globals

**Owners:** [FEAT-UI-01](#feat-ui-01), [FEAT-STRAT-CATALOG_BLOCKS](#feat-strat-catalog-blocks), [FEAT-PLUG-REGISTER_CONTRIBUTIONS](#feat-plug-register-contributions). **Source:** §25.8, §36.10, §21.4.

Preserve Dockview and dual-block value/condition behavior, but static private imports/global BLOCK_REGISTRY and mutable reference dataclasses are not architecture exemptions. Register immutable versioned descriptors with exact scope/disposers; pure contracts remain non-features.

### TRD-005 — Canonical RSI and native policy win over sample code

**Owners:** [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_MOMENTUM](#feat-ind-calculate-momentum), [FEAT-SIM-EXECUTE_TICKS](#feat-sim-execute-ticks). **Source:** §37.4, §37.5, §37.9, §56.3.

RSI belongs to Indicators; both smoothed gain and loss zero yields50, gain-only100, loss-only0. Use qualified nopython kernels with fastmath=False. The sample Plugins path, flat-series100 and fastmath=True are corrected reference defects, not alternate semantics.

### TRD-006 — Do not invent SQX binary framing

**Owners:** [FEAT-STRAT-IMPORT_SQX](#feat-strat-import-sqx), [FEAT-ANA-IMPORT_EXTERNAL_LEDGERS](#feat-ana-import-external-ledgers). **Source:** §38.4, §38.5, §38.9.

The source fixed116-byte claim conflicts with its table ending fixed fields at117 and the supplied struct format (105 bytes and15 fields, while code reads16). Treat these as inconsistent unverified examples. Implement only a verified format/version grammar from authorized fixtures; reject unknown framing and never deserialize executable objects. Full-fidelity is a per-cell acceptance goal, not current support.

### TRD-007 — Bounded neural inference without hidden dependencies

**Owners:** [FEAT-RES-INFER_MODELS](#feat-res-infer-models), [FEAT-RES-LABEL_NEURAL_DATA](#feat-res-label-neural-data). **Source:** §39.3, §39.6, §39.8.

NumPy is an existing numerical dependency; the goal is no mandatory PyTorch/TensorFlow production inference, not literal zero dependencies. Pin activation/preprocessing/class order/calibration/threshold; >0.55 directional template and ties neutral. Never replace bundle semantics with the sample fixed ReLU/argmax.

### TRD-008 — Label parameterizations remain distinct

**Owners:** [FEAT-RES-LABEL_NEURAL_DATA](#feat-res-label-neural-data). **Source:** §39.2, §39.8, §56.1.

Additive ATR barriers and multiplicative return-volatility barriers are two explicitly versioned label policies, not interchangeable formulas. Classification labels are not strategy fills; unresolved OHLC collision excludes an ambiguous fit row and missing horizon is unavailable.

### TRD-009 — One worker transport and separate health/lease clocks

**Owners:** [FEAT-ORCH-MANAGE_REMOTE_WORKERS](#feat-orch-manage-remote-workers), [FEAT-IFACE-OPERATE_JOBS](#feat-iface-operate-jobs). **Source:** §23.2, §40.3, §40.8.

Canonical remote control is authenticated HTTP plus SSE/snapshots. Map example endpoint names to it; the WebSocket wording cannot create a second authority or browser-worker channel. Three missed5s heartbeats can quarantine new work; the30s lease/fence independently decides acceptance of active attempts.

### TRD-010 — One roadmap; added checks remain mandatory

**Owners:** [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics), [FEAT-WS-DISTRIBUTE_APPLICATION](#feat-ws-distribute-application), [FEAT-ORCH-EXECUTE_LOCAL_WORK](#feat-orch-execute-local-work). **Source:** §29, §56.14.

U0–U13 is the only release sequence. The six added exit checklists are acceptance groupings. Preserve their new24h soak and desktop/headless distribution obligations; do not move U13 target support into core by interpreting checklist numbering as milestones.

### TRD-011 — Examples do not override exact authority and state rules

**Owners:** [FEAT-AGT-RUN_WORKFLOWS](#feat-agt-run-workflows), [FEAT-AGT-MANAGE_CLAIMS](#feat-agt-manage-claims), [FEAT-AGT-GOVERN_RESEARCH_SEARCH](#feat-agt-govern-research-search), [FEAT-RES-GOVERN_CAMPAIGNS](#feat-res-govern-campaigns), [FEAT-RES-GOVERN_HOLDOUTS](#feat-res-govern-holdouts). **Source:** §41, §42.8, §49, §52.

Use accepted_attempts=active+completed+failed+cancelled+invalid+refused; pre-admission denials separate. Claim content immutable and status append-only; conversation storage is Workspace-owned; workflow outputs retained under A06. Historic source shorthand is traceability, not alternative behavior.

### TRD-012 — Source identifiers have artifact scope

**Owners:** [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics). **Source:** §27, §54, §55.

A raw FR-UI-001 in this specification is not the different FR-UI-001 in the current UI README. Keys are source artifact+raw ID. Master/detail rows remain explicit summary/refinement links; do not implement duplicate tasks or add their counts to normalized FRs.

### TRD-013 — 572 classes is not 572 features or a fabricated name list

**Owners:** [FEAT-STRAT-CATALOG_BLOCKS](#feat-strat-catalog-blocks). **Source:** §36.10.

Retain the ten declared counts and every named example. Catalogue entries belong to numerical/Strategy behavior owners. Full donor enumeration and variant/opposite mappings require EVD-DONOR-01; unresolved identities are not generated as placeholders or asserted implemented.

### TRD-014 — Performance and connector support require actual evidence

**Owners:** [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics), [FEAT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS](#feat-sim-model-ticks), [FEAT-BRK-CONNECT_MARKET_FEEDS](#feat-brk-connect-market-feeds), [FEAT-STRAT-GENERATE_TARGETS](#feat-strat-generate-targets). **Source:** §12.1, §37.6, §38.4, §40.8, §56.13, §56.14.

No universal500 tests/core or twenty-year wall time, unverified source licence, provider availability, binary fidelity or compiler support is asserted. Required evidence is assigned to named features; missing evidence blocks that advertised combination, not ownership closure.

### TRD-015 — Atomic feature boundary and shared-helper rule

**Owners:** [FEAT-PLUG-REGISTER_CONTRIBUTIONS](#feat-plug-register-contributions), [FEAT-STRAT-DEFINE_AST](#feat-strat-define-ast), [FEAT-UI-VIEW_COLLECTIONS](#feat-ui-view-collections). **Source:** §21, §22, §25.5, §26.1.

Each feature delivers one cohesive public outcome with independent removal behavior. A schema/type/helper/form button/algorithm variant/role/task/gate is not automatically a feature. Reusable UI grid/review foundations have a real typed rendering/review service outcome and no business authority.

### TRD-016 — Pure numerical calculations do not require acquisition

**Owners:** [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_TREND](#feat-ind-calculate-trend), [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_MOMENTUM](#feat-ind-calculate-momentum), [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_VOLATILITY](#feat-ind-calculate-volatility), [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_VOLUME_FLOW](#feat-ind-calculate-volume-flow), [FEAT-IND-TRANSFORM_SERIES](#feat-ind-transform-series), [FEAT-IND-DETECT_CANDLE_PATTERNS](#feat-ind-detect-candle-patterns), [FEAT-IND-CALCULATE_MARKET_PROFILES](#feat-ind-calculate-market-profiles). **Source:** §21.3, §37.5, §56.4.

Numerical providers accept validated typed inputs. Data acquisition/alignment is operation-gated only when requested; a pure local calculation does not require a Data provider to mount. Native composition remains through approved owner contracts.

### TRD-017 — Thin desktop packaging is a selected target

**Owners:** [FEAT-WS-DISTRIBUTE_APPLICATION](#feat-ws-distribute-application). **Source:** §2.3, §29.

Select an Electron thin desktop wrapper around the existing application plus a headless Docker image for the new distribution gate. No new SPA, business engine or native credential authority is introduced; owner ratification and install/update/uninstall evidence precede release.

### Evidence not supplied or not established by the specification

These are **not orphan requirements**: their scope, accountable feature, closure evidence and blocking gate are fixed. They cannot honestly be turned into completed implementation facts. In particular, assigning an owner does not make an internally inconsistent binary layout correct, supply missing donor class names, choose an unspecified production tick algorithm, or produce a measured twenty-year performance budget. A lower-reasoning executor must not invent those facts; the assigned owner must produce the named qualified artifact before the blocked implementation/advertisement.

#### EVD-DONOR-01 — Full 572-class identity and behavior inventory

**Owner:** [FEAT-STRAT-CATALOG_BLOCKS](#feat-strat-catalog-blocks). **Blocking gate:** U5 named core; no complete-donor-parity claim until closed.

**Known limit:** Source lists ten counts and examples, not all572 class names/semantics.

**Required closure evidence:** Pin rights-cleared donor manifest/class IDs/source hashes; map every item to typed block/provider/variant/opposite and tests or justified alias/retired mechanism. Category totals reconcile; no missing item gets fabricated behavior.

#### EVD-SQX-01 — Qualified SQX XML/binary/settings grammar

**Owner:** [FEAT-STRAT-IMPORT_SQX](#feat-strat-import-sqx). **Blocking gate:** Before each external compatibility cell is advertised (U13).

**Known limit:** §38.9 examples are internally inconsistent and contain no verified fixture evidence.

**Required closure evidence:** Pin format-version/member/framing/field grammar and authorized minimal/complex/truncated/unknown corpus; verify round-trip counts/scales/times/unknowns; preserve SQStats opaque unless safely parsed.

#### EVD-TICKS-01 — Production generated-tick method algorithm

**Owner:** [FEAT-SIM-MODEL_TICKS](#feat-sim-model-ticks). **Blocking gate:** Before U2 generated-method implementation/qualification.

**Known limit:** Source intentionally does not select a production generator ID or fully specify its algorithm.

**Required closure evidence:** Publish versioned path/density/timing/price/spread/volume/session/gap/end policies and stream goldens; no silent default, fixture generator is benchmark-only.

#### EVD-PERF-01 — Hardware/runtime and absolute workload budgets

**Owner:** [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics). **Blocking gate:** U0 binding; U2 core gates; subsequent affected releases.

**Known limit:** Ratios and some service limits are specified; exact machine and absolute per-fixture20Y/compile caps are not measured/pinned.

**Required closure evidence:** Record fixtures/hardware/runtime/toolchains, finite caps, comparator and repetition protocol; freeze absolute budgets before scale acceptance; publish actual pass/fail.

#### EVD-CONTRACT-01 — Current owner contract/provider binding

**Owner:** [FEAT-WS-BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS](#feat-ws-build-diagnostics). **Blocking gate:** Before consuming production implementation.

**Known limit:** This register pins selected feature boundaries/keys; it has not executed or revalidated every current provider/schema.

**Required closure evidence:** Ratify exact selected keys/modules/DTOs in owner READMEs, map compatible existing records/aliases, and record six distinct evidence stages at implementation commit. Do not copy target strings into a manifest as proof a provider exists.

#### EVD-PROVIDER-01 — Source rights and actual feed capability

**Owner:** [FEAT-BRK-CONNECT_MARKET_FEEDS](#feat-brk-connect-market-feeds). **Blocking gate:** Before activating each connector, core or U13.

**Known limit:** No specific equity/futures feed vendor is named by the source; planned connectors are not active connections.

**Required closure evidence:** Each installed independently configured provider publishes instruments/history/schema/rates/rights/credential/failure checks and synthetic/offline conformance; unconfigured provider remains unavailable.

#### EVD-TARGET-01 — Supported target/toolchain and operator matrix

**Owner:** [FEAT-STRAT-GENERATE_TARGETS](#feat-strat-generate-targets). **Blocking gate:** U9 primary code targets; U13 later targets.

**Known limit:** A named export target is not compilation/behavior evidence.

**Required closure evidence:** Install pinned approved toolchain; parse/compile and compare indicator/signal/execution/inference goldens for each advertised node/clock/operator combination; UNVERIFIED_TARGET otherwise.

#### EVD-ML-01 — Model/operator repeatability and qualification

**Owner:** [FEAT-RES-VALIDATE_MODELS](#feat-res-validate-models). **Blocking gate:** Before enabling each U11 supported model path.

**Known limit:** Template hyperparameters and provider list are development choices, not measured predictive usefulness.

**Required closure evidence:** Independent train-only/purge/embargo/golden inference/model-card/baseline and strategy-level qualification; disclose nondeterministic device repeatability; no provider self-promotion.

## 11. Validation and controlled maintenance

Run the register-only structural checks:

```powershell
python validate_traceability.py traceability_register.json --self-test --report validation_report.json
```

Run the additional source check in a local checkout containing the pinned specification:

```powershell
python validate_traceability.py traceability_register.json `
  --spec "docs/dev/SQX/HaruQuantAI_Unified_Specification.md" `
  --self-test --report validation_report.json
```

The optional source check verifies the Git blob and the current identifier set. A later specification revision correctly fails the pinned hash until this register is deliberately reconciled. Windows checkout line-ending conversion changes raw bytes; supply the Git blob’s UTF-8/LF content for an exact byte check. Even a successful byte/ID check is not a substitute for semantic review or real acceptance tests.

The required-dependency topological order is stored in JSON for structural inspection. It is **not an executor-ready phased implementation plan**: task splitting, exact code signatures/defaults where not already normative, donor qualification, path-bounded changes and actual provider evidence still belong to the next implementation-plan work. No feature may fabricate a missing provider or infer a passing gate from this register.

When a source requirement changes, update its artifact-scoped source row, owning FR(s), catalogue entries, applicable NFRs, dependencies, tests and release gate together. Preserve retired IDs as aliases rather than reusing them. Regenerate Markdown/HTML from canonical JSON and rerun both integrity and fault-injection checks. Never turn a source count discrepancy into a silent dropped requirement.
